title: Ning Li and Smalley took $400,000 in Army Research Lab money and delivered nothing
summary: Eric Davis tells of Ning Li and Smalley took $400,000 in Army Research Lab money and delivered nothing, about 1990s-2000s at University of Alabama Huntsville, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and and they made off with $400,000 in army research lab money and didn't produce a producible for it. They didn't deliver anything for that money.

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a scientist named Eric Davis, introduced as a Pentagon scientist, says that two researchers at the University of Alabama in Huntsville, Ning Li and Larry Smalley, took $400,000 from the Army Research Lab, a US Army research agency, sometime between the 1990s and 2000s. According to Davis, they delivered nothing for the money, and he mentions another researcher, Travis Taylor, as part of the story. He tells it as a warning about funded fringe research that produced no results.
